descriptionChirho: A gentilic adjective (חֶבְרוֹנִי) designating members of the Levitical clan descended from Hebron son of Kohath, used in the organization of Levitical duties under David (1 Chr 26:23,30,31; Num 3:27; 26:58). Multilingual evidence confirms a single gentilic concept: eng 'the Hebronite(s)/Chevronites', spa 'el/los hebronita(s)', hin 'हेब्रोनी', arb 'الْحَبْرُونِيّ', kor '헤브론 사람', swa 'Wahebroni'. The variation between prepositional-prefixed (לַחֶבְרוֹנִי 'of/to the Hebronites') and article-only forms is purely syntactic, not semantic.
